manifest.name: dsh-ofm-quota
manifest.description: DSH 配额与积分插件（dsh-ofm-quota × dsh-credits-hub 融合版）：统计每次对话落在哪个接口、耗多少 token/积分，额度耗尽时自动切换到同名模型的其他接口；左侧栏一个「额度与积分」面板（额度在上、积分在下）加一个 8788 看板图标，模型选择器旁再挂一枚当前接口余额胶囊。官方路由（deepseek-account）按量计费，默认**不**参与自动兜底（可显式开启），面板会把它单独标为「官方 · 计费」。
manifest.author: dx906

bundle.text:
# dsh-ofm-quota bundle patch.
#
# 一行 insert 即挂载 Host 半身；浏览器半身由 package.json 的 dsh.client 声明，
# 并绑定在 name 为裸包名的这一行上（子路径行不会携带半身）。
#
# 0.2.0 起，原 dsh-credits-hub 的 Host 半身（credits/host.js）也挂在这一行下面，
# 不再单独安装。配置分两层：
#   - 顶层字段：ofm-quota 自己的（enabled / autoSwitch / triggerCodes / warnBelowPct …）
#   - credits 子键：原 dsh-credits-hub 的配置，键名一字未改，缺省即原默认值
#
# 注意：改本文件**不会**热重载（auto reload 是关的，插件重载是手动的）。要生效必须
# 重启 DSH，或用 dsh-unlag 触发一次刷新；按浏览器的刷新键没用。
- insert:
    - id: ofm-quota
      name: 'dsh-ofm-quota'
      config: {}
      # 需要改配置时把 config 展开（全部可选，缺省即默认值）：
      #
      # config:
      #   enabled: true
      #   autoSwitch: true
      #   warnBelowPct: 20           # 任一渠道余额低于该百分比就在面板顶部提示，0 = 关闭
      #   officialFallback: null     # 官方路由兜底；null = 关闭（按量计费，别默认开）
      #   credits:                   # 原 dsh-credits-hub 的配置
      #     wbBaseUrl: 'http://127.0.0.1:8788'
      #     wbPanelPassword: 'admin'
      #     cacheTtlMs: 15000
      #     requestTimeoutMs: 20000
      #     profile: desktop

readme.text: [**中文**](./README.md) | [English](./README.en.md)

**看得见还剩多少，用光了自动换。**

给 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 上的 [Our Free Model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model) 加上**接口配额管理**：实时统计每次对话真正落在哪个接口上、花了多少 token；额度耗尽时自动切到**同名模型的其他接口**。左侧栏多一个「额度与积分」入口、模型选择器旁多一枚余额胶囊，把「还剩多少」摊开给你看。

> **0.2.0 起并入 dsh-credits-hub 的全部能力。** 原来分散在左侧栏「积分」页的东西——WB Proxy（8788）面板的账户余额、OFM 渠道账号、已填的提供商密钥、一键领取每日积分——现在与接口额度合成**同一个左侧栏面板**：额度在上、积分在下，一屏看完；WB Proxy 看板另给一个左侧栏图标，因为它整页嵌的是别人的 SPA。两个插件从此只需要装一个。**渠道与余额只画一次**：这条改动之后，积分那半不再列一遍 OFM 渠道账号——同一批渠道在两段里各有一份，读的人会以为「额度与积分」又被拆开了；积分那半只回答「这些余额来自哪个账户、怎么领」。**右侧栏不再有本插件的页签**：0.2.0 短暂用过右侧栏 tab，按「接口额度和积分其实是一件事，右侧栏看不直观」的反馈，0.2.1 把入口整体迁到了左侧栏与输入区。

> **官方路由默认不兜底。** DSH 内核自带的 `deepseek-account`（DeepSeek 官方账号）是**按量计费**的，和 Our Free Model 的免费车道是两套体系。本插件默认**不会**在你不知情时切过去——额度用尽就如实报错。想开兜底要显式配置 `officialFallback`；面板里官方路由永远单独标成「官方 · 计费」并沉底，不会混在免费车道里。

[](https://github.com/dx906/dsh-ofm-quota/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[](./LICENSE)
[](./package.json)
[](#安装)
[](#安装)

---

Our Free Model 把十几家免费与协付渠道聚合成一个 provider，好处是一次登录到处能用。但它带来三个麻烦：

1. **你看不见剩多少。** 每个渠道的积分是独立的一池，TRAE 剩 382、Qoder 剩 400、ZCode 已经 0——这些数字散在各家控制台里，聚合面板上不显示。
2. **用光了才知道。** 触发一线是 HTTP 429 或 `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`。那一刻对话正卡在中间，你只能手动去模型选择器里翻下一个。
3. **累计消耗是笔糊涂账。** 一天下来跑了多少 token、哪家吃了大头，没有地方对得上。

这个插件补的就是这三件事。它不是 OFM 的替代品，是**架在它旁边的仪表盘与自动挡**。

旁听内核的 `llm/stream` 水位，记录每次请求实际派发到的 `provider/model` 与适配器回报的 token 用量（输入 / 输出 / 思考 / 缓存读）。

两个数据源交叉印证：

| 来源 | 是什么 | 可信度 |
|---|---|---|
| **我们旁听** `llm/stream` | 本进程内每一次真实派发 | 实时，但只覆盖本进程 |
| **渠道包权威台账** `token-ledger.json` | 渠道包自己按 `direct\|provider\|accountId\|model` 逐日累计 | 含历史全部请求，是权威值 |

界面上两者都给：**模型用量明细**里能看到「我们旁听 773 次 / 渠道包权威 1628 次」这样的对照，差异说明有请求发生在插件安装之前。

额度耗尽时**自动切到同名模型的其他接口**。默认到此为止——不再往下走官方计费。

```
接口额度耗尽（QUOTA_EXHAUSTED / 429 / 授权失效）
      ↓
沿「同名族」找还有额度的备用接口
      ↓

**为什么默认不兜底到官方**：`deepseek-account` 是 DSH 内核自带的官方账号路由，**按量计费**。
自动兜底等于在用户不知情时花钱，而且失败是静默的——用户只会觉得「怎么变慢了」，
看不到账单。把失败如实抛出去，让用户自己决定值不值得花这个钱，才是正确的默认。

readme.section: 3. 左侧栏：额度与积分一屏
readme.text:
左侧栏多一个「额度与积分」图标。面板里**接口额度在上、积分在下**——两者本就是同一件事，不用来回切换。WB Proxy（8788）看板另占一个图标。

**余额是渠道账号的属性，不是模型的属性。** 同一渠道下的几十个模型共享一份积分池，所以卡片只画一张渠道卡（可展开看每个账号），而不是为每个模型重复同一个数字——后者只会得到满屏「额度未知」。模型级用量收在「用量与趋势」折叠组里，默认收起。

readme.section: 4. 模型选择器旁的余额胶囊
readme.text: 模型选择器右侧多一枚小胶囊：`provider 5,451`。它显示的是**上一次请求真的走了谁**，不是 composer 里选的谁——因为浏览器端没有能读当前模型的服务，而「实际在用的接口」本来就是更有用的那个语义。15 秒轮询一次；取不到余额时显示「余额取不到」，不编数字。

readme.section: 5. 会解释自己的自动切换
readme.text:
- **同模型跨渠道对比**：同一模型挂在多个渠道上时（融合后这是常态），按「是否冷却 → 可用额度比例 → 近期失败率」排序，`★` 标出此刻该走的那条。
- **余额预警**：任一渠道余额低于 `warnBelowPct`（默认 20%）时，面板顶部挂一条窄带。**只对能读到总额的账号生效**——没有分母就不算比例，不编数字。
  > 实测（2026-11-04，8 个真实渠道账号）：渠道包回的 `total` 与 `remaining` 是同一个数（`codearts` 6485.99/6485.99、`qodercn` 795/795、`trae` 300/300），比例恒为 100%，所以这条窄带在渠道账号上**实际不会出现**；`packages` 的分项与 `row` 也不同步（`trae` 的包全部 `remaining: 0`，而 `row.remaining` 仍是 300），同样不能当分母。这套数据源只给「当前可用」，不给「周期总量」——要让它真的响，只能等上游补字段，或改成绝对阈值（属新语义，需另行拍板）。
- **近 14 天趋势**：按天汇总的请求量柱状图，hover 看当天的 token 与错误数。

左侧栏 → **额度与积分**：额度在上、积分在下，同一屏看完。

额度与积分从上到下是几层，越往下越少看：

```
额度与积分
├─ 三块指标        可用余额 / 接口条数 / 今日调用（单位跟在标签后，不挤数字）
├─ 新鲜度一行      接口清单同步于…、余额读取于…
├─ 渠道卡 × N      一渠道一张，展开看账号明细与积分包

**为什么折叠**：上一版把八块内容平铺在一屏里，看到余额之前要先读完三段说明，47 行
模型明细还把页面直接顶长。现在首屏只留指标、新鲜度和渠道卡，其余按需展开——收起时
不渲染，展开才渲染。「同步 / 刷新余额」也收在第一组里：清单 60 秒节流自动补、余额超
5 分钟自动补读，手动只是备用手段。

左侧栏 → **WB Proxy**：整页嵌入 `http://127.0.0.1:8788` 的看板，独立面板，iframe 懒加载、撑满窗口。

模型选择器右侧 → `wb-proxy 5,451`：上一次请求实际走到的接口，及它的余额。

| 段 | 内容 | 数据来源 |
|---|---|---|
| **三块指标** | 可用余额、接口条数、今日调用（每个渠道都有数值且单位一致才求和，否则退回渠道数） | `/api/ofm-quota/status` |
| **接口额度** | 一渠道一张卡；模型明细、跨渠道对比、按天趋势收在三个折叠组里 | OFM 落盘文件 + `credits.balances` RPC |
| **积分** | WB Proxy 账户积分、已填密钥、一键领取每日积分（渠道与余额只在「接口额度」里画一次） | `ledger.json` + `our-free-model/subscriptions` + `cordis.patch.yml` + 8788 API |
| **WB Proxy** | `http://127.0.0.1:8788` 用量看板整页嵌入 | 直连 iframe（见下） |

`取不到` 是**如实报告**，不是失败：Cline 没配凭据时，插件不会伪造一个 0（那会让你以为积分没了）。

readme.section: 接口清单与额度：怎么做到「实时且正确」
readme.text:
面板顶部那行小字是这套数据的自证，两个数据面各带自己的时间戳：

```
接口清单 47 条 · 同步于 12 秒前        余额读取于 3 分钟前
```

readme.section: 接口清单与额度：怎么做到「实时且正确」
readme.text:
- **清单不会缺**：`/status` 发现接口索引为空时，后台补一次目录同步（60 秒节流、in-flight 去重），**不阻塞本次响应**——首次打开不会看到「0 个接口」，下一次轮询就是真实条数（实测首帧 0 条 → 3 秒后 47 条）。
- **额度不会陈旧**：任何渠道的余额超过 5 分钟没更新，`/status` 同样在后台补读一次。放着不动自己也会变新，不会停在一排昨天的数字上。
- **每条额度都自证时刻**：卡片里写 `额度读取于 3 分钟前`；读不到就写「取不到（最近一次读取失败）」，绝不显示一个安静的 0。
- **来源可辨**：`observed`（真读到的）/ `manual`（手填兜底，标「手填」）/ `unknown`（取不到）。手填只在读不到真值时生效，不会盖住之后每次真实刷新。
- **读不到不等于不存在**：OFM 未启动、文件缺失时返回 `ok:false`，已有清单原样保留——「此刻读不到」不等于「那些接口不存在」。
- **清单会跟着上游收缩**：Our Free Model 升级后删掉的接口，下次目录同步时会从清单里消失。只删 `source: 'our-free-model'` 的条目，历史真的调用过的 `observed` 条目保留。旧版对清单只增不删，所以上游删掉的接口会一直挂在页面上（实测删掉 27 条后索引 47 → 20）。

readme.section: 关于 WB Proxy（8788）的嵌入方式
readme.text:
8788 是一整页 SPA，登录令牌存在它**自己的 sessionStorage** 里。所以这里不打同源代理——代理改不了那个存储域，而代用户认证属越权。实测它没有发 `X-Frame-Options`，也没有 `CSP frame-ancestors`，浏览器允许直连嵌入，于是就是一个 `loading="lazy"` 的 iframe 指过去。

它自己的登录闸门会在框里弹一次，照常登录即可。若 8788 没在跑，这一段就是空白——页面里留了「在新窗口打开」的兜底链接。

- **DSH**（DeepSeek Harness），提供 profile / bundle / cordis 插件机制。
- **[dsh-our-free-model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model)**，提供被管理的渠道。本插件依赖它的落盘文件与 `channel-pack` RPC。
- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。

**零运行时依赖。** 只用 Node 内置模块（`node:crypto` / `fs` / `os` / `path` / `url`），`client.js` 连 import 都没有。装进来的字节就是你审得完的字节——没有 `node_modules` 里的意外。

> 本插件只读 OFM 的**落盘文件**，不修改它、不替代它。两者可以独立升级。

本包**不打到 npm**（`private: true`）。从源码打 tarball 装进 profile——这样装进去的字节和你审过的源码一致。

```sh

git clone https://github.com/dx906/dsh-ofm-quota.git
cd dsh-ofm-quota

readme.section: 1. 打本地 tarball 到 profile 的 vendor/
readme.text:
mkdir -p "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/vendor"
pnpm pack --pack-destination "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/vendor"

readme.section: 4. 在 profile 目录解析依赖
readme.text:
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts
```

> **改完 tarball 必须同步更新 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 里该包的 `integrity`**（sha512-base64），否则 `--frozen-lockfile` 会失败。同版本号时 pnpm 还会认为 `Already up to date`，需要先 `rm -rf node_modules/dsh-ofm-quota` 再 `--force`。

装完**从托盘退出并重开 DSH**。

readme.section: 4. 在 profile 目录解析依赖
readme.text:
> **开发时用 `link:` 更方便。** 打 tarball 那条路每改一行都要 `pnpm pack` → 拷进 vendor → `pnpm install` → 重启，四步。把 dependencies 写成 `"dsh-ofm-quota": "link:D:/AI/dsh-ofm-quota"` 之后，改代码只需重启 DSH（或用 dsh-unlag 刷新），省掉打包与安装。代价是 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 里记的是链接而不是 integrity，换机器要重装一次。

> ⚠️ **不重启等于没装。** 运行中的宿主是旧代码——这一点在开发期间骗过我们一次：磁盘上明明修好了，行为却还是坏的。插件启动时会打一行 `[ofm-quota] loaded build=<hash>`，拿它确认版本。

**web 与 desktop 共用同一个 profile，一次安装两边都生效。**

桌面端的 `desktop` profile 由 Electron 应用独占，CLI 直接 `dsh plugin add` 会报：

```
profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

所以上面的手工步骤是桌面端的正路（应用内插件管理器也可以，但本包建议手工装，理由见下）。

1. 重开 DSH，点左侧栏的**额度与积分**。
2. 点**同步**——插件从本机落盘文件读取接口清单与历史用量。

| 数据源 | 路径 | 提供什么 |
|---|---|---|
| Our Free Model catalog | `$DSH_HOME/our-free-model/catalog.json` | free / EAC / Kilo 三条车道的接口清单（`entries` / `sealIds` / `kiloRows`） |
| 渠道包账号 | `$DSH_HOME/channel-pack/state.json` | 已登录的渠道账号（trae / qodercn / loomy / zcode …） |
| 渠道包用量 | `$DSH_HOME/channel-pack/token-ledger.json` | **权威 token 用量**，按 `direct\|provider\|accountId\|model` 逐日累计 |

3. 点**刷新余额**——拿到各渠道的真实剩余积分。
4. 正常用。额度耗尽时它会自己换接口。
> **为什么不走它们的 HTTP API？** `/api/our-free-model/*` 受内核 connection 的 `dsh-auth-*` cookie 围栏保护（无 launch token → 401），`/api/channel-pack` 是 exact Fetch route（非 owner peer → 403）。同进程读文件是被支持的路径，也是唯一稳的路径。

readme.section: 1. 余额：为什么要绕一个弯
1. 余额：为什么要绕一个弯
readme.text:
这样拿到的余额会落进接口行的 `quotaRemaining`，自动切换不必等 429 就能**提前**换走。

宿主没有 `createSharedFetchHandler` 时只降级（返回 `no-connection`），绝不抛错。

> **`balance: null` + `error` 绝不能当 0。** 渠道包自己记录过这个已修复的报障——查询失败显示成 0 会让用户以为积分没了。本插件只在拿到真实数字时才把 `quotaKnown` 置真；全部账号都查不到时返回 `ok:false` 并带上原因。

readme.section: 2. 自动切换：用内核原生的两个水位钩子
readme.text:
不碰 `ctx.llm`（它没有 middleware），用内核自己的 waterfall：

```
agent/request-error  → 失败且命中触发码 → 决定目标 → 记 pending → 返回 {kind:'retry'}
agent/request        → loop 重跑本 step → 读出 pending → 改写 provider/model → 丢弃 reasoningEffort
```

三个必须做对的细节：

1. **触发码要覆盖两个命名体系。** 内核的 `normalizeLlmFailure` 会**原样保留**适配器自己抛出的 `code`（`dsh-llm/lib/index.js:402-410` 的 `ownErrorCode`），并不把它映射成内核码。所以要同时列内核码与生态码：

readme.section: 2. 自动切换：用内核原生的两个水位钩子
readme.text:
- 内核码：`QUOTA` / `ACCOUNT_QUOTA` / `RATE_LIMIT` / `INVALID_CREDENTIAL` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`
   - OFM 生态码（`src/http.js:29-51`，channel-pack 沿用同一套）：`QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`（**最关键**）/ `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED` / `LANE_LOCKED`

`QUOTA` 与 `ACCOUNT_QUOTA` 必须**都写**：`dsh-llm-deepseek-account` 会把前者升格成后者（`lib/index.js:455-460`），只写一个就少触发一半。

2. **换路必须丢弃源路由的 `reasoningEffort`。** 那是上一条路由自己的思考档位，目标适配器可能不认这个 id。与路由无关的字段（`maxTokens` 等）原样保留。

readme.section: 2. 自动切换：用内核原生的两个水位钩子
readme.text:
- **同名匹配**按归一化族名（剥掉 `-free` / `-preview` / `-latest` / `-stable`）。实测 `trae/deepseek-v4.1-flash` 与 `our-free-model/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` 互为备用接口。
- **官方路由永不作为「同名备用接口」**，它只能是兜底——否则兜底永远走不到。
- **`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 是请求级失败**，只换接口不打冷却，避免一个 1M 窗口接口被几轮长对话误判成不可用。
- **失败接口进冷却**（默认 15 分钟），冷却期内不会被优先选中。
- **每 step 切换次数有上限**（默认 3），防止链式循环放大延迟。
- **组合顺序天然正确**：本插件在 `dsh.profile.bundles` 末尾，注册晚于 `dsh-base` 里的 `llm-retry`，所以 llm-retry 先尝试重试，只有它放弃后才轮到换接口。

插件的 HTTP 路由挂在 `/api/ofm-quota`，比内核的 `/api` 更长，**会先命中**——所以准入检查必须自己做，不能指望内核兜底。

有 `connection` 时用它的 `admit` 裁决；没有时按 loopback + 同源结构化复刻。**比较的是含端口的 `url.host`，不是 hostname**（只比 hostname 会让本机任意端口的页面越权）。fail-closed。

`$DSH_HOME/ofm-quota/settings.json`，或卡片 / HTTP 改：

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "autoSwitch": true,
  "maxSwitchesPerStep": 3,

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `autoSwitch` | `true` | 自动切换开关 |
| `triggerCodes` | 9 个码（见下） | 触发切换的失败码。**必须同时覆盖内核码与 OFM 生态码** |
| `maxSwitchesPerStep` | `3` | 每 step 最多切换次数（防止链式循环） |
| `cooldownMs` | `900000` | 失败接口冷却时长（15 分钟） |
| `windowHours` | `24` | 用量统计窗口 |
| `warnBelowPct` | `20` | 余额低于该百分比时在面板顶部提示。**`0` 关闭**。只对能读到 `total` 的账号生效 |
| `officialFallback` | **`null`（关闭）** | 全部第三方不可用时的兜底路由。**官方按量计费，所以默认关**；开启请写真实 provider id：`{ "provider": "deepseek-account", "model": "deepseek-flash" }` |
| `syncCatalog` | `true` | 启动时自动从 OFM catalog 同步接口清单 |
| `manualQuota` | `{}` | 手填额度（真实读取优先，手填只兜底） |

`triggerCodes` 默认值：

```js
// 内核码
'QUOTA', 'ACCOUNT_QUOTA', 'RATE_LIMIT', 'INVALID_CREDENTIAL', 'CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED',
// Our Free Model / channel-pack 适配器码
'QUOTA_EXHAUSTED', 'PERMISSION_DENIED', 'AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED', 'LANE_LOCKED',

**设置迁移是并集式的**：升级插件时会补齐新增的默认触发码，但**不会删掉你自己加的码**，且幂等。

想手填额度还有两条路：

- `POST /api/ofm-quota/quota` `{provider, model, remaining, total}` — 给单个接口
- `POST /api/ofm-quota/provider-quota` `{provider, remaining, total}` — 给整个渠道

上表是**运行期设置**（存在 `settings.json`，可热改）。下面这几个不一样：它们是**插件装载配置**，写在插件包根目录 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `config.credits` 子键里（键名与原 dsh-credits-hub 一字未改）；不想动包的话，也可以在 profile 的 patch 层按 `id: ofm-quota` 再覆盖一条。

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ofm-quota
      name: 'dsh-ofm-quota'
      config:

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `wbBaseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:8788` | 8788 面板地址 |
| `wbPanelPassword` | `admin` | 8788 面板口令 |
| `cacheTtlMs` | `15000` | 快照缓存时长 |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `20000` | 上游请求超时 |
| `profile` | `desktop` | 读取的 profile 名 |

**改这些必须重启 DSH**（或用 dsh-unlag 刷新）。cordis 的 auto reload 是关的，插件重载是手动的——按浏览器的刷新键没有任何用。

全部挂在 `/api/ofm-quota`（同源，与宿主 `/api` 同一信任围栏）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/status` | 卡片用：接口行、各 lane 汇总、额度可得性、最近切换/失败 |
| GET | `/endpoints` | 仅接口行 |
| POST | `/sync` | 从落盘文件同步接口清单与用量 |
| POST | `/balances` | **读渠道真实剩余积分**（`credits.balances`）；可只给 `{provider}` |
| POST | `/settings` | 改开关（校验白名单字段） |
| POST | `/quota` | 手填单接口额度 |
| POST | `/provider-quota` | 手填整个渠道额度 |
| POST | `/unblock` | 手动解除冷却 |
| POST | `/reset` | 清空用量与切换记录 |

`/balances` 只接受**已知 provider**（静态 12 渠道表 + 已登录 / 已同步过的），避免被当成任意上游的探测跳板。

另有一组挂在 `/api/credits-hub`（原 dsh-credits-hub 的路由，路径一字未改，所以旧的调用方不用跟着改）：

| 方法 | 路径 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/status` | 积分页用：8788 账户、OFM 渠道账号、已填密钥、签到状态，带 `at` 采集时间 |
| POST | `/claim` | 一键领取每日积分。响应里带 `results[]`（每个账号领没领到）与**领后的新快照** `snapshot` |

`/claim` 只回答「领没领到」和一句 msg，**不回答「领到多少」**。想知道加了多少积分，前端拿领前领后两次快照按 uid 相减——这就是面板上那个 `+N` 徽标的来源。上游若滞后导致差值为 0，就什么都不显示。

readme.section: 额度可得性（实测结论，不是免责声明）
readme.text: **渠道包的十二个渠道能读到真实剩余积分**——点卡片上的「刷新余额」即可，走的是渠道包自己的 `credits.balances` RPC，拿到的就是 Our Free Model 卡片上显示的那个数字（例如 TRAE 的「剩余积分 382」对应返回值的 `balance.total`）。

readme.section: 额度可得性（实测结论，不是免责声明）
readme.text:
| 车道 | 能读额度 | 依据 |
|---|---|---|
| channel（trae / qoder / qodercn / codearts / loomy / raccoon / minimax / zcode / cline / gemini / lobsterai / opencode） | ✅ 真实积分 | 渠道包 `credits.balances` RPC，`balance.total` |
| free（匿名免密车道） | ❌ | 只有 `429` + `retry-after`，无额度端点 |
| EAC（协付） | ❌ 个人额度 | 只有 GitHub 授权状态与池级容量 |
| Kilo | ❌ | 没有额度概念 |
| aggregate（自带 key 的 provider） | ❌ | 需对每个 provider 单独实现余额查询 |

读不到额度的车道不装死：它们靠**失败反馈**触发切换。

```sh
pnpm test                  # 两套都跑
pnpm run test:host         # 仅 host 半身
pnpm run test:client       # 仅浏览器半身
pnpm run deadcode          # 死代码扫描

`scripts/selftest.mjs`（host 半身，**17 组**）覆盖：三个钩子的真实 payload 形状与返回契约、同名备用接口解析（含官方路由及其旧别名必须被排除）、**官方兜底默认关闭 / 显式开启 / 必须能再关掉**、落盘文件同步（catalog 三种 id 形态 / 渠道账号 / token-ledger）、渠道余额 RPC（owner Peer 与非 owner 403 的对照）、**路由准入围栏的正反例**、**有界内存**（turn 表上限 512、路由表上限 256）、**额度来源优先级（真实读取压过手填）**、**逐日趋势按天分桶且不并入跨天累计**、**余额预警阈值白名单（越界丢弃 / `0` 可关）**、HTTP 路由、契约审计三条、**死代码审计四条**（账号累加 / 解除冷却 / 失败回写 / reset）。

`scripts/client-test.mjs` 覆盖：ModuleLoader 入口契约、左侧栏两个图标与 `main` 面板的 **id↔key 配对**（少一边就是点了没反应，且完全静默）、图标必须带 `order`（没有会被宿主收进「更多」）、余额 chip 只注册在 `conversation.input.right` 且不碰 single 槽 `conversation.input.activity`、组件在最小 props 下不抛错、**路由 URL 不得带前导斜杠**（反代前缀或 `dsh-app://` 壳下会 404/跨源）。

全部离线运行，不启动宿主。CI 在 Node 22.19 与 24 上跑同一套（`.github/workflows/test.yml`）——因为零依赖，CI 里连 install 步骤都不需要。
> **测试哲学：每条关键断言都做反向对照。** 把修复改回坏代码，确认测试真的会红。这条规矩是被现实教出来的——我们曾写过一条**永远不会执行**的断言（`if (requested.length > 0)` 里的 `requested` 恒为空数组），于是「已锁定该缺陷」这句话整整骗了自己一轮。

**Q：装了没反应？**
A：多半是没重启。宿主进程里跑的是旧代码。看日志有没有 `[ofm-quota] loaded build=`。

**Q：余额全是「未知」？**
A：先点「刷新余额」。如果仍未知，说明 `connection` 服务不可用——那是个真实降级，插件不会伪造数字。Cline 之类没配凭据的渠道会一直显示未知，这是对的。

**Q：为什么卡片不按模型显示额度？**
A：余额根本不在模型粒度上。同一渠道的几十个模型共享一份积分池，按模型重复画只会得到满屏「额度未知」。

**Q：自动切换没触发过？**
A：只有额度真的耗尽才会触发。如果 `switches: 0` 且 `failures: 0`，说明你还没撞上过额度墙。

**Q：它会偷偷联网吗？**
A：会联网，但不是偷偷的。启动 3 秒后它会主动打一次上游读余额（`bootstrap()`）。`settings.syncCatalog` 只能关掉清单同步，关不掉这个自举。想要零自动外联需要再加开关。

**Q：和 OFM 的自动更新冲突吗？**
A：如果你用包管理器（pnpm）装了本插件，本插件是独立包，与 OFM 各自的更新互不影响。

- 只有渠道车道能**提前**读到余额；free / EAC 个人 / Kilo / aggregate 没有额度端点，只能靠失败反馈触发切换。
- 余额按**渠道账号**展示，不按模型。
- 真实读取到的余额压过用户手填值；手填只在读不到时兜底。
- 路由 `/api/ofm-quota` 自带信任围栏，因为它比内核 `/api` 更长、会先命中。

| 组件 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| DSH | 内核 `0.2.1-rc.2` 上实测通过 |
| dsh-our-free-model | `2.5.8` 上实测通过 |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

DSH 的插件 API 仍在快速演进（`0.1.x` / `0.2.x` 并存）。本插件对内核契约的依赖点都写在注释里并标了出处文件与行号，升级内核时按那些锚点检查。

本插件是独立第三方作品，与 DeepSeek、Our Free Model 及各渠道提供方均无隶属关系。它只读取本机落盘文件并调用本机 DSH 进程内的 RPC，不上传任何数据到第三方服务器。

各渠道的免费额度由渠道方提供，其条款与可用性由渠道方决定。
[MIT](./LICENSE)

- **[Our Free Model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model)** — 本插件管理的渠道聚合层，也是本项目的存在理由。
- **dsh-better-sidebar** — 早期右侧栏卡片的形态参考（0.2.1 起改用左侧栏原生席位）。
- **dsh-my-guardian** — 原生 sidebarRightTabs + slots 写法的参考实现。
[中文](./README.md) | **English**

**See how much is left. Switch automatically when it runs out.**

Adds **endpoint quota management** to [Our Free Model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model) on [DSH (DeepSeek Harness)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): it reports, in real time, which endpoint each conversation actually lands on and how many tokens it spends, and when an endpoint runs dry it switches to **another endpoint serving the same model**. A card in the right sidebar lays out how much is left.

> **As of 0.2.0 this absorbs all of dsh-credits-hub.** What used to live on a separate left-sidebar **Credits** page — 8788 panel account balances, OFM channel accounts, configured provider keys, one-click daily credit claim — now sits in the same right-sidebar tab, as three segments alongside endpoint quotas. One plugin instead of two. **The old left-sidebar Credits entry is no longer registered**: the icon disappearing after the upgrade is expected behaviour, not a broken install.

> **The official route is not a fallback by default.** DSH's built-in `deepseek-account` (the official DeepSeek account) is **billed per token** and is a different system from Our Free Model's free lanes. This plugin will **not** silently switch over to it — when you run out, it reports the failure honestly. Enabling the fallback is an explicit opt-in via `officialFallback`. In the panel, official routes are always labelled "official · billed" and sorted to the bottom, never mixed in with the free lanes.

[](https://github.com/dx906/dsh-ofm-quota/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[](./LICENSE)
[](./package.json)
[](#installation)
[](#installation)

---
Our Free Model aggregates a dozen-odd free and co-paid channels into a single provider. One login, everything usable — but it brings three annoyances:

1. **You can't see what's left.** Each channel has its own credit pool. TRAE is at 382, Qoder at 400, ZCode at 0 — and those numbers live in each vendor's console, invisible from the aggregated panel.
2. **You find out only when it's gone.** The tripwire is an HTTP 429 or `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED`, fired mid-conversation. All you can do is open the model picker and hunt for the next one by hand.
3. **Cumulative spend is guesswork.** How many tokens you burned today, and which channel ate most of them, doesn't add up anywhere.
This plugin fills exactly those three gaps. It is not a replacement for OFM — it is a **dashboard and an automatic transmission bolted onto its side**.

It listens in on the kernel's `llm/stream` watermark and records the `provider/model` each request is actually dispatched to, plus the token usage the adapter reports back (input / output / thinking / cache reads).

Two data sources cross-check each other:

| Source | What it is | Trust |
|---|---|---|
| **Our listener** on `llm/stream` | Every real dispatch inside this process | Live, but only covers this process |
| **The channel pack's authoritative ledger** `token-ledger.json` | Accumulated by the channel pack itself per `direct\|provider\|accountId\|model` per day | Covers all history; the authoritative value |
The UI shows both: **Model usage detail** displays comparisons like "773 dispatches observed / 1628 authoritative", where the gap means some requests happened before the plugin was installed.

When quota runs out it **switches to another endpoint of the same model**. By default it stops there — it does not go on to bill the official route.

```
endpoint quota exhausted (QUOTA_EXHAUSTED / 429 / credential revoked)
      ↓
look along the "same-name family" for a backup endpoint that still has quota
      ↓

**Why the official route is off by default**: `deepseek-account` is DSH's built-in official
account route and is **billed per token**. Falling back to it automatically spends the user's
money without asking, and the failure is silent — the user just notices things got slower and
never sees the bill. Reporting the failure and letting the user decide whether the spend is
worth it is the correct default.
A new **Quotas & Credits** card in DSH's native right sidebar, showing each channel's **remaining credits** and live consumption.

**Balance is a property of the channel account, not of the model.** The dozens of models under one channel share a single credit pool, so the card draws one row per channel (expandable to per-account detail) instead of repeating the same number for every model — which would only produce a wall of "quota unknown". Model-level usage is folded away in the secondary **Model usage detail** section, collapsed by default.

Endpoint quotas, credits, and the 8788 panel share one right-sidebar tab with a segmented switch on top. **The inactive segment is unmounted entirely** — the 4-second quota poll and the 30-second credits poll stop with it instead of spinning in the background.
When the fallback switches endpoints you need to know why. Three blocks in the card answer that:

- **Cross-channel comparison**: when one model hangs off several channels (routine after the merge), rows are ordered by *cooling down → usable balance ratio → recent failure rate*, with `★` marking the one that would be picked right now.
- **Balance warning**: a narrow banner appears at the top when any channel drops below `warnBelowPct` (default 20%). **It only applies to accounts that report a total** — no denominator, no percentage, no invented number.
- **14-day trend**: request volume per day as bars; hover for that day's tokens and errors.

Right sidebar → **Quotas & Credits**. One tab, three segments:

```
┌─ Quotas & Credits ─────────────────────┐
│ Quotas │ Credits │ 8788                │  ← segmented switch
├────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ⚠ below 20%  TRAE 8%                  │  ← warning strip (optional)

| Segment | Content | Data source |
|---|---|---|
| **Quotas** | Channel balances, model usage, cross-channel comparison, daily trend | OFM on-disk files + `credits.balances` RPC |
| **Credits** | 8788 account credits, OFM channel accounts, configured keys, daily claim | `ledger.json` + `our-free-model/subscriptions` + `cordis.patch.yml` + the 8788 API |
| **8788** | The `http://127.0.0.1:8788` usage dashboard, embedded whole | Direct iframe (see below) |
`balance unknown` is **an honest report, not a failure**: when Cline has no credentials configured, the plugin does not fabricate a 0 — that would read as "your credits are gone".

8788 is a full-page SPA whose login token lives in **its own sessionStorage**. That rules out a same-origin proxy — a proxy cannot reach that storage domain, and authenticating on the user's behalf would overstep. It sends neither `X-Frame-Options` nor a `frame-ancestors` CSP, so the browser allows a direct embed: one `loading="lazy"` iframe pointed at it.
Its own login gate pops up inside the frame the first time; log in there as usual. If 8788 is not running, the segment is blank, and there is an "open in a new window" link as the way out.

- **DSH** (DeepSeek Harness), providing the profile / bundle / cordis plugin machinery.
- **[dsh-our-free-model](https://github.com/Ebony-Vinyl/dsh-our-free-model)**, providing the channels being managed. This plugin depends on its on-disk files and its `channel-pack` RPC.
- **Node.js** `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.

**Zero runtime dependencies.** Only Node builtins (`node:crypto` / `fs` / `os` / `path` / `url`) — `client.js` has no imports at all. The bytes you install are bytes you can finish reading; no surprises hiding in `node_modules`.

> This plugin only *reads* OFM's on-disk files. It does not modify OFM and does not replace it. The two can be upgraded independently.

This package is **not published to npm** (`private: true`). Build a tarball from source and install it into your profile, so the bytes that land on disk are the bytes you reviewed.

```sh

git clone https://github.com/dx906/dsh-ofm-quota.git
cd dsh-ofm-quota

readme.section: 1. Pack a local tarball into the profile's vendor/
readme.text:
mkdir -p "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/vendor"
pnpm pack --pack-destination "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop/vendor"

readme.section: 4. Resolve dependencies in the profile directory
readme.text:
cd "$DSH_HOME/profiles/desktop"
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --offline --ignore-scripts
```

> **After changing the tarball you must update that package's `integrity` (sha512-base64) in `pnpm-lock.yaml`**, or `--frozen-lockfile` fails. With the same version number, pnpm will also consider itself `Already up to date`; `rm -rf node_modules/dsh-ofm-quota` first, then `--force`.

Then **quit DSH from the tray and start it again**.

readme.section: 4. Resolve dependencies in the profile directory
readme.text: > **While developing, `link:` is more convenient.** The tarball route costs four steps per line changed: `pnpm pack` → copy into vendor → `pnpm install` → restart. Writing `"dsh-ofm-quota": "link:D:/AI/dsh-ofm-quota"` in dependencies cuts that to a restart (or a dsh-unlag refresh). The trade-off is that `pnpm-lock.yaml` records a link rather than an integrity hash, so a fresh machine needs one reinstall.

readme.section: 4. Resolve dependencies in the profile directory
readme.text:
> ⚠️ **Not restarting means not installed.** The running host is still the old code — a trap that fooled us once during development: the fix was on disk, the behaviour was still broken. On startup the plugin logs `[ofm-quota] loaded build=<hash>`; use that line to confirm the version.

**Web and desktop share the same profile, so one install covers both.**

The desktop `desktop` profile is owned exclusively by the Electron app, so a CLI `dsh plugin add` reports:

```
profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application
```

Hence the manual steps above are the proper route on desktop. (The in-app plugin manager works too, but this package recommends the manual path — see above.)

1. Restart DSH and open **Quotas & Credits** in the right sidebar.
2. Click **Sync** — the plugin reads the endpoint list and historical usage from on-disk files.

| Data source | Path | What it provides |
|---|---|---|
| Our Free Model catalog | `$DSH_HOME/our-free-model/catalog.json` | The endpoint lists for the free / EAC / Kilo lanes (`entries` / `sealIds` / `kiloRows`) |
| Channel-pack accounts | `$DSH_HOME/channel-pack/state.json` | Logged-in channel accounts (trae / qodercn / loomy / zcode …) |
| Channel-pack usage | `$DSH_HOME/channel-pack/token-ledger.json` | **Authoritative token usage**, accumulated per `direct\|provider\|accountId\|model` per day |

3. Click **Refresh balances** — this fetches each channel's real remaining credits.
4. Use DSH normally. When an endpoint runs out, it switches by itself.

> **Why not go through their HTTP APIs?** `/api/our-free-model/*` is fenced by the kernel connection's `dsh-auth-*` cookie (no launch token → 401), and `/api/channel-pack` is an exact Fetch route (non-owner peer → 403). Reading files in the same process is a supported path, and the only one that reliably works.

The channel pack registers its balance RPC as an **exact Fetch route** on the connection (`/api/channel-pack`), and exact routes return **403 to any non-owner Peer** (`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:830`). That is precisely why Our Free Model's own host half cannot read balances either and has to delegate to its browser half.

This plugin creates an **in-process owner Peer** inside the host half and dispatches through it:

> **`balance: null` plus an `error` must never be read as 0.** The channel pack has itself recorded this bug report (already fixed): showing a failed query as 0 makes users think their credits are gone. This plugin only sets `quotaKnown` when it has a real number, and returns `ok:false` with a reason when no account can be queried.

We don't touch `ctx.llm` (it has no middleware). We use the kernel's own waterfalls:

```
agent/request-error  → failed and code is a trigger → pick target → record pending → return {kind:'retry'}
agent/request        → loop reruns this step        → read pending → rewrite provider/model → drop reasoningEffort
```

Three details that have to be right:

1. **Trigger codes must cover two naming systems.** The kernel's `normalizeLlmFailure` **passes through** the `code` thrown by the adapter itself (`ownErrorCode` at `dsh-llm/lib/index.js:402-410`) and does not map it to a kernel code. So both families have to be listed:

- Kernel codes: `QUOTA` / `ACCOUNT_QUOTA` / `RATE_LIMIT` / `INVALID_CREDENTIAL` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`
   - OFM ecosystem codes (`src/http.js:29-51`; channel-pack uses the same set): `QUOTA_EXHAUSTED` (**the critical one**) / `PERMISSION_DENIED` / `AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED` / `LANE_LOCKED`

`QUOTA` and `ACCOUNT_QUOTA` must **both** be present: `dsh-llm-deepseek-account` promotes the former into the latter (`lib/index.js:455-460`), so listing only one halves the trigger rate.

2. **Switching routes must drop the source route's `reasoningEffort`.** That is the previous route's own thinking level, and the target adapter may not recognise the id. Fields unrelated to routing (`maxTokens` and friends) are carried over untouched.

3. **Never return retry when `signal` is already aborted**, or the loop will rerun a step that was cancelled.

Other behaviours:

- **Same-name matching** is done on a normalized family name (stripping `-free` / `-preview` / `-latest` / `-stable`). In practice `trae/deepseek-v4.1-flash` and `our-free-model/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free` serve as each other's backup.
- **The official route is never used as a "same-name backup"** — it can only be the fallback, otherwise the fallback would never be reachable.
- **`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` is a request-level failure**: switch endpoint but don't cool the source down, so that a 1M-window endpoint isn't written off by a few long conversations.
- **Failed endpoints enter cooldown** (15 minutes by default) and are not preferred during it.
- **Switches per step are capped** (3 by default) to keep chains from amplifying latency.
- **Bundle ordering works out naturally**: this plugin sits at the end of `dsh.profile.bundles`, so it registers after `llm-retry` in `dsh-base` — llm-retry gets its attempt first, and only once it gives up does endpoint switching come into play.

readme.section: 3. The route carries its own trust fence
readme.text:
The plugin's HTTP route lives at `/api/ofm-quota`, which is longer than the kernel's `/api` and therefore **matches first** — so the admission check has to be its own; it cannot lean on the kernel.

When `connection` is available, its `admit` decides; otherwise the plugin reproduces the same rules structurally for loopback + same-origin. **It compares `url.host` including the port, not the hostname** (comparing hostnames alone would let a page on any local port cross the boundary). Fail-closed.

`$DSH_HOME/ofm-quota/settings.json`, or via the card / HTTP:

```json
{
  "enabled": true,
  "autoSwitch": true,
  "maxSwitchesPerStep": 3,

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `autoSwitch` | `true` | Automatic failover switch |
| `triggerCodes` | 9 codes (below) | Failure codes that trigger a switch. **Must cover both naming systems** |
| `maxSwitchesPerStep` | `3` | Maximum switches per step (prevents chains) |
| `cooldownMs` | `900000` | Cooldown for a failed endpoint (15 minutes) |
| `windowHours` | `24` | Usage statistics window |
| `warnBelowPct` | `20` | Show a banner when a channel's balance falls below this percentage. **`0` disables it.** Only applies to accounts that report a `total` |
| `officialFallback` | **`null` (off)** | Fallback route when all third parties are unavailable. **Off by default because the official route is billed per token**; to enable, use the real provider id: `{ "provider": "deepseek-account", "model": "deepseek-flash" }` |
| `syncCatalog` | `true` | Sync the endpoint catalog from the OFM catalog at startup |
| `manualQuota` | `{}` | Hand-entered quota (real reads win; manual is only a fallback) |

The default `triggerCodes`:

```js
// kernel codes
'QUOTA', 'ACCOUNT_QUOTA', 'RATE_LIMIT', 'INVALID_CREDENTIAL', 'CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED',
// Our Free Model / channel-pack adapter codes
'QUOTA_EXHAUSTED', 'PERMISSION_DENIED', 'AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED', 'LANE_LOCKED',

**Settings migration is union-based**: upgrading the plugin fills in newly added default trigger codes, but **never deletes codes you added yourself**, and it is idempotent.

There are two more ways to enter quota by hand:

- `POST /api/ofm-quota/quota` `{provider, model, remaining, total}` — for a single endpoint
- `POST /api/ofm-quota/provider-quota` `{provider, remaining, total}` — for a whole channel

The table above is **runtime settings** (stored in `settings.json`, editable while running). The keys below are different: they are **plugin loading configuration**, written under the `credits` sub-key of `config` in the `cordis.patch.yml` at the root of the plugin package, with names byte-for-byte those of the original dsh-credits-hub. To override without touching the package, add another entry keyed `id: ofm-quota` in the profile's patch layer.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: ofm-quota
      name: 'dsh-ofm-quota'
      config:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `wbBaseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:8788` | 8788 panel base URL |
| `wbPanelPassword` | `admin` | 8788 panel password |
| `cacheTtlMs` | `15000` | Snapshot cache lifetime |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `20000` | Upstream request timeout |
| `profile` | `desktop` | Profile to read from |
**Changing these requires a DSH restart** (or a dsh-unlag refresh). cordis auto-reload is off and plugin reload is manual — pressing the browser refresh key does nothing.
All under `/api/ofm-quota` (same-origin, sharing the host's `/api` trust fence):

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/status` | What the card uses: endpoint rows, per-lane totals, quota availability, recent switches/failures |
| GET | `/endpoints` | Endpoint rows only |
| POST | `/sync` | Sync the endpoint list and usage from on-disk files |
| POST | `/balances` | **Read real channel credits** (`credits.balances`); may take just `{provider}` |
| POST | `/settings` | Change switches (validated against a field allowlist) |
| POST | `/quota` | Hand-enter quota for one endpoint |
| POST | `/provider-quota` | Hand-enter quota for a whole channel |
| POST | `/unblock` | Manually lift a cooldown |
| POST | `/reset` | Clear usage and switch history |

`/balances` accepts only **known providers** (the static 12-channel table plus anything logged in or synced), so it can't be used as a probe against arbitrary upstreams.

A second group sits under `/api/credits-hub` (the former dsh-credits-hub routes, paths unchanged, so existing callers keep working):

| Method | Path | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/status` | Feeds the Credits segment: 8788 accounts, OFM channel accounts, configured keys, check-in state, plus the `at` collection time |
| POST | `/claim` | One-click daily credit claim. The response carries `results[]` (per account: claimed or not) and the **post-claim snapshot** `snapshot` |

`/claim` answers "did it claim" and a message — **never "how much was claimed"**. To show the gain, the client subtracts the pre- and post-claim snapshots per uid; that difference is where the `+N` badge comes from. If upstream lag makes the difference zero, nothing is shown at all.

**The channel pack's twelve channels expose real remaining credits.** Click **Refresh balances** on the card: it goes through the pack's own `credits.balances` RPC and returns the same number shown on Our Free Model's card (for example, TRAE's "382 credits left" corresponds to `balance.total` in the response).

| Lane | Quota readable | Basis |
|---|---|---|
| channel (trae / qoder / qodercn / codearts / loomy / raccoon / minimax / zcode / cline / gemini / lobsterai / opencode) | ✅ real credits | channel pack `credits.balances` RPC, `balance.total` |
| free (anonymous, no-credential lane) | ❌ | Only `429` + `retry-after`; no quota endpoint |
| EAC (co-paid) | ❌ per-user quota | Only GitHub authorization state and pool-level capacity |
| Kilo | ❌ | No concept of quota |
| aggregate (bring-your-own-key providers) | ❌ | Would require a bespoke balance query per provider |
Lanes with no readable quota don't fake it: they trigger failover from **failure feedback**.

```sh
pnpm test                  # run both suites
pnpm run test:host         # host half only
pnpm run test:client       # browser half only
pnpm run deadcode          # dead-code scan

`scripts/selftest.mjs` (host half, **17 groups**) covers: the real payload shapes and return contracts of all three hooks, same-name backup resolution (including the official route and its legacy alias, which must be excluded), **the official fallback being off by default / opt-in / and able to be turned off again**, on-disk sync (three id shapes in the catalog / channel accounts / token-ledger), the channel balance RPC (owner Peer versus a 403 for non-owners), **positive and negative cases for the route admission fence**, **bounded memory** (512 turn/step entries, 256 agent entries), **quota source precedence (a real read beats a manual entry)**, **the daily trend bucketing per day rather than folding into the cross-day total**, **the balance-warning threshold whitelist (out-of-range dropped, `0` allowed to disable)**, the HTTP routes, the three contract-audit cases, and the **four dead-code audit cases** (account accumulation / cooldown release / failure write-back / reset).

`scripts/client-test.mjs` covers: the ModuleLoader entry contract, the tab type and the two keyed slot registrations, the component not throwing under minimal props, and **route URLs never carrying a leading slash** (which 404s or crosses origins behind a reverse-proxy prefix or inside a `dsh-app://` shell).
Everything runs offline; no host is started. CI runs the same suite on Node 22.19 and 24 (`.github/workflows/test.yml`) — and because there are zero dependencies, CI needs no install step at all.

> **Testing philosophy: every critical assertion gets an adversarial control.** Revert the fix back to the broken code and confirm the test actually goes red. Reality taught us this rule — we once wrote an assertion that **could never execute** (`requested` inside `if (requested.length > 0)` was always an empty array), so "this defect is locked down" fooled us for an entire round.

**Q: I installed it and nothing happens?**
A: You almost certainly didn't restart. The host process is running the old code. Check the log for `[ofm-quota] loaded build=`.

**Q: Every balance says "unknown"?**
A: Click **Refresh balances** first. If they're still unknown, the `connection` service is unavailable — a real degradation; the plugin will not invent numbers. Channels without credentials, such as Cline, will always show unknown, and that is correct.

**Q: Why doesn't the card show quota per model?**
A: Balance simply isn't at model granularity. The dozens of models under one channel share one credit pool, so drawing it per model would only produce a wall of "quota unknown".

**Q: Failover never triggered?**
A: It only triggers when quota is genuinely exhausted. If `switches: 0` and `failures: 0`, you simply haven't hit the quota wall yet.

**Q: Does it phone home behind my back?**
A: It does go online, but not surreptitiously. Three seconds after startup it makes one upstream call to read balances (`bootstrap()`). `settings.syncCatalog` only disables catalog sync, not this bootstrap. Truly zero automatic egress would need another switch.

**Q: Does it conflict with OFM's auto-update?**
A: If you installed this plugin with a package manager (pnpm), it is an independent package, so the two update independently.

- Only the channel lane can read balances **ahead of time**; free / per-user EAC / Kilo / aggregate have no quota endpoint and can only trigger failover from failure feedback.
- Balances are shown per **channel account**, not per model.
- A real read always beats a user-entered value; manual entries only fill the gap when nothing can be read.
- The `/api/ofm-quota` route carries its own trust fence, because it is longer than the kernel's `/api` and therefore matches first.

| Component | Version |
|---|---|
| DSH | tested against kernel `0.2.1-rc.2` |
| dsh-our-free-model | tested against `2.5.8` |
| Node.js | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |

DSH's plugin API is still evolving quickly (`0.1.x` and `0.2.x` coexist). Every kernel contract this plugin relies on is documented in its comments with the source file and line number, so check those anchors when upgrading the kernel.

This plugin is an independent third-party work, unaffiliated with DeepSeek, Our Free Model, or any channel provider. It only reads on-disk files on your machine and calls RPCs inside the local DSH process; it uploads no data to third-party servers.

Free quota on each channel is provided by that channel, and its terms and availability are the channel's to decide.
